articles.title: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
articles.description: A Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled that prediction markets' sports-related events contracts are not swaps, and therefore aren't subject to federal regulatory oversight.

articles.title: OG.com seeks CFTC approval for single-stock perpetual futures
articles.description: OG.com, recently spun out of Crypto.com, joins Coinbase, Kalshi and Kraken parent Payward in seeking approval to bring perpetual futures to individual US stocks.

articles.title: Meta opens early access program for new Muse features

articles.title: Ex-CFTC leader to leave Blockchain Association after CLARITY vote fails

articles.title: Blockchain Association sees leadership shift shortly after crypto Clarity Act fizzles
articles.description: The trade group will be run again by its original CEO, Kristin Smith, when Summer Mersinger leaves at the end of a long congressional tussle.

articles.title: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
articles.description: Anthropic has committed $11.6 billion over seven years to Akamai's cloud infrastructure, a bet on CPUs that could grow to about $20 billion, and in an unusual arrangement, Akamai is giving Anthropic a potential stake of up to 5% of its stock that grows as Anthropic spends more.
